g.title: J10
g.text: EPS J10 (zone Z3), wing W1: drivers Q24 (W1A, BURN_W1A PB10) and Q25 (W1B, BURN_W1B PE6)

g.title: W7A_B
g.text: M22759/33-24 (Micro-Fit minimum); pairs twisted; 0.88 A for 12 s, one resistor at a time; under the EPS, along the +X wall gap below the EPS (within 20 mm of y = 0) and down the (+X, -Y) bundle to the burn board; loop 50 mohm, 44 mV

g.title: W7A_S
g.text: sense pair, twisted, down the +X hinge-side strip and along the D-200-82 splice pair on the -Z end frame (y +34 ... +5) to the splices' far ends

g.title: BB_W1
g.text: wing W1 burn board (two burn resistors), solder pads

g.title: HS_W1
g.text: wing W1 deployed-state sensor lead, TE D-200-82 nickel-barrel splice

g.title: J11
g.text: EPS J11 (zone Z2), wing W2: drivers Q26 (W2A, BURN_W2A PB9) and Q27 (W2B, BURN_W2B PE7)

g.title: W7B_S
g.text: sense pair, twisted, into the top ends of the D-200-82 splice pair standing in the widened -X hinge-side strip (z -41.0 ... -11.8)

g.title: BB_W2
g.text: wing W2 burn board (two burn resistors), solder pads

g.title: HS_W2
g.text: wing W2 deployed-state sensor lead, TE D-200-82 nickel-barrel splice

g.title: J12
g.text: Pico-Clasp 8 pos, gold terminals (EPS J12, was 4)
EPS J12 (zone Z5): AntS supply, I2C side A (U80 B side) and side B 0x32 through 0 ohm jumpers (SQSO-ICX-001 E15)

g.title: W7C
g.text: M22759/33-28; pairs 1+3, 2+4, 5+6 (side A), 7+8 (side B); 0.61 A peak on two wires per pole (34 %), 37 mV

g.title: ANTS
g.text: ISIS AntS pigtail, soldered on termination tab TB-ANT
through the -Z end-frame cut-out at (-31, -16); pinout from the AntS ICD

g.title: W12A
g.text: twisted pair; microamperes; 10 k at the EPS end limits a short to the frame to 1.7 mA

g.title: J16
g.text: 5 pos (pin 3 not connected on the EPS)

EPS J16 (zone Z2): pole 1 pack-return FET drive (PACK domain); pole 2 array inhibit, active high: C2 VCTL via 10 k, NO2 to the gate of tracker clamp Q40 (EPS_BOARD_DESIGN E 6.2, SMA-B13). Fallback: pins 4-5 to a second SPDT DS2B in the +Z standoff of the same rail

g.title: W12B
g.text: pole 1 triple (1, 2, 3; 3 spare) and pole 2 pair (4, 5) twisted; microamperes; pole 2 active high (a chafe to the frame cannot disable the trackers)

g.title: DS2
g.text: deployment switch DS2, two-pole (DPDT) (rail -X-Y, -Z), solder terminals

g.title: W12C
g.text: DS3's NO wire dropped (EPS Version E); +X wall gap at y -39.5 ... -45.5 (beside W4A), from the +Z rail end down to the EPS

g.title: W12D
g.text: -Y wall strip and the -Y deck slot; pole A in DS2's drive; pole B carries VCTL to the gate of tracker clamp Q41 with the pin in (active high)

g.title: RBF
g.text: RBF switch, two poles, solder terminals
